I only opened the package and had them out for 20 minutes or so, they were that bad. Now I have to wait until Monday when UPS opens to get the package out of my house. Hopefully someone else can avoid a similar issue. If you have allergies of any kind, it really isn't worth it. And even if you aren't sensitive, these are probably not healthy to have around. Who knows what is really in this anyway...100% polyester is rather nondescript and can mean many things. Not happy with this purchase at all.Additionally, when I removed it from the package, the fabric had stuck together in places and small bits of white paint pulled off when separated. These are just terrible quality.
